summary: Local database-first reconciliation reproduced the M1186 missing-child boundary and isolated two narrow source defects. Campaign rooms do not carry sceneId even though Region plans and Tile projections do; the install path therefore selects zero static Tiles for an existing or new room. The reread expectation also passes the projection wrapper to a generic collection normalizer, producing an accidental expected count of three metadata values instead of the canonical seven Tiles per selected room. No runtime or staging action occurred.

queries: Reviewed installer and package fixture expectations
databaseFirst.reconciliation: M1187 stayed inside the authorized local-only boundary. The live M1186 receipt remains valid as fixture evidence of the observed derived count 3, while this local reconciliation classifies that count as a source-calculation defect and derives the canonical expected count 7 from the package Tile projection and Region-plan scene identity.

decision.reason: M1186 exposed a concrete local defect: missing room-to-Scene identity prevents Tile payload selection, while the reread expectation masks the canonical seven-Tile requirement as a three-value metadata artifact. A narrow source/test correction is required before another live write can be considered.
decision.nextBoundary: M1188: implement and locally validate the narrow Region-plan Scene identity and static Tile projection correction in the package-owned installer/reread path; no runtime or staging action.

remainingBlockers: Campaign room records omit sceneId; the installer compares Tile sceneId against undefined and selects zero Tile payloads.
Persistent reread expectation reads the projection wrapper instead of its tiles array and reports a non-canonical count of three.
Both owned Signal/Rune Scenes remain incomplete in the M1186 fixture evidence.
Persistent-world write authority, post-restart committed completeness, Tram/Core final maps, player behavior, and player acceptance remain unproven.
